items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: In fact, he did all the arranging mostly for, uh, Joe Oliver after, after, after Joe and Louis broke up.

ctx.x: He's from New Orleans. Yeah. New Orleans was there. Left New Orleans earlier, you know, settled in Chicago, I suppose.

He was, uh, he was a trumpet player and could play piano too. And arranged. And arranged, great arranger. In fact, he did all the arranging mostly for, uh, Joe Oliver after, after, after Joe and Louis broke up.
Did you ever hear that record, Stingery Blues, that Joe Oliver made? I made that thing. Oh, you made it?
